content.content: The markers interface reads and writes the marker file, `.deccy/markers.json`, under the root.
content.rationale: S5-marker-file (ysqqrqsp) fixes where the file lives; S2-ifs gives the marker file its own handle, so a change to node reach cannot re-scope the marker file, nor the reverse. Its read and write are M-markers-file's, the module that realizes this interface. The state directory stays untracked and the file's contents stay S5-marker-schema's.
